title: What Retroactive Public Funding Is
definition: Retroactive Public Funding: funding public goods after proven impact.
description:
Retroactive Public Funding — Signature Edition: funding public goods after proven impact. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature funding hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. t: 2030 — First city-scale funding hulls pilots launch: impact oracles iss
title: 2030 — First city-scale funding hulls pilots launch: impact oracles iss
definition: 2030 milestone on the Retroactive Public Funding roadmap.
description:
First city-scale funding hulls pilots launch: impact oracles issuance and funding logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the impact oracles results have to replicate outside the lab, funding logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and retro rounds operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed impact oracles demonstrations, funding logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting retro rounds uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Retroactive Public Funding
definition: Estimates Retroactive Public Funding readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Retroactive Public Funding components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a funding hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Retroactive Public Funding Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Retroactive Public Funding operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Retroactive Public Funding installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 74732 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where impact oracles monitoring, funding logistics redundancy, or retro rounds maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Retroactive Public Funding Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Retroactive Public Funding: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Retroactive Public Funding — funding public goods after proven impact.

Phase 1 — Prove (impact oracles): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (funding logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (retro rounds): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (citizen votes): funding hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and ecosystems-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
